notes.title: UPDATE 16/05/2024
notes.content:
▼New Features
・Implemented a clear screen
・You can check your clear time on the clear screen
・Feel free to try RTA for the best time!


▼Updates
・Fixed some text
・Time now stops when displaying memos
・Made enemy sounds (footsteps, voices) easier to hear


▼Developer's Note
Thank you for playing "Akayashiki"!
I was really happy to see people actually playing and posting videos of the game on YouTube and other platforms right after release :)
This was the first game I've ever made.
I'm still an amateur, but I plan to keep updating it, so please look forward to that!

notes.title: UPDATE : 05/15/2024
notes.content:
The game occasionally froze during chases, so we implemented a process to reduce the load.
We look forward to your continued support of Akayashiki.
